jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organization operating within a global industrial sector.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate daily operational and supply chain activities.
• Work closely with internal teams and external partners.
• Monitor inventory levels and support planning activities.
• Resolve operational issues and ensure smooth execution.
• Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.

A successful Logistics Operations Specialist should have:

• First experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or a similar environment.
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
• Comfortable working with data and planning activities.
• Proactive, hands-on, and eager to learn.
• Strong communicator who enjoys working with different stakeholders.
• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.

Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.
• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.
Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.
Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.
Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.
Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.
Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.
Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.
Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate and monitor daily rail transportation activities across Europe.
• Manage transport disruptions, delays, and operational escalations.
• Act as the main point of contact between internal stakeholders and external transport partners.
• Monitor wagon availability, utilization, and transport capacity.
• Support sourcing of additional transport capacity when required.
• Prepare operational reports and track logistics KPIs.
• Follow up transport costs, documentation, and invoicing processes.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.
• Initial experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or a related field is a plus.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data and Excel.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic international environment.
• Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Our client is an industrial organisation in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Manager your responsibilities are:

• Coordinate day-to-day office activities to ensure an organised and efficient workplace.
• Manage office supplies and place orders to maintain availability of essential materials.
• Arrange meetings and prepare meeting rooms for internal and external visitors.
• Handle incoming calls, emails and correspondence, ensuring timely follow-up.
• Maintain administrative records and keep office documentation accurate and accessible.
• Coordinate with external suppliers for office-related services and practical requests.
• Support the organisation of business travel, appointments and calendar planning.
• Identify office needs and coordinate actions that help daily operations run smoothly.

A successful Office Manager should have:

• At least two years of experience coordinating office administration and daily workplace activities.
• Ability to work in English and French or Dutch, at least B2 level is required for two of these languages.
• Ability to manage calendars, meetings, correspondence and practical office requests.
• Confidence working with office documentation, records and administrative processes.
• Ability to coordinate suppliers and follow up on office-related services.
• Strong organisational skills to manage several priorities in a structured way.
• A clear and professional approach to communication with colleagues and visitors.

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Automation Technical Sales & Project Manager
jobs.description:
• An international engineering company designs and delivers high-technology equipment for heavy industrial production facilities. 
• Operating on projects worldwide, the organization combines technical expertise, innovation, and complex project execution in an international environment. 

Jobomschrijving

• Define electrical and automation solutions aligned with customer requirements. 
• Review technical specifications, customer documentation, and contractual requirements. 
• Develop and validate E&A budgets covering engineering and equipment costs. 
• Present and technically defend proposals while supporting commercial negotiations. 
• Manage project execution, ensuring coordination, planning, budgeting, and compliance. 
• Ensure customer satisfaction, risk management, and adherence to HSE standards. 

• Minimum 10 years of experience in technical sales and/or industrial project management. 
• Master's degree in Civil or Industrial Engineering. 
• Strong expertise in industrial instrumentation, control, and automation systems. 
• Proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project and SAP. 
• Fluent in French and English; German is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

Our client is a european fintech operating in the financial services and payments sector. Its Brussels-based offices offer a dynamic, modern and easily accessible working environment within a rapidly evolving industry.

Jobomschrijving

• Act as the AML Compliance Officer and oversee the organisation's AML/CFT framework
• Supervise KYC, CDD, sanctions screening, PEP reviews and transaction monitoring activities
• Manage, coach and develop a team of 6 compliance professionals
• Review and validate complex investigations and escalate sensitive cases when required
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and internal controls
• Coordinate regulatory reporting, audits and compliance reviews
• Collaborate closely with legal, risk and operational teams to ensure regulatory compliance

• Unlimited right to work in Belgium is mandatory for this position : applications without a valid work permit will not be considered.
• Degree in Law, Finance, Compliance, Risk Management or a related field
• Minimum 7 years of experience in AML/CFT, compliance or financial crime within financial services, payments or fintech
• Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or Dutch is considered an advantage
• Strong knowledge of Belgian and European AML regulations, KYC/CDD, sanctions and transaction monitoring
• Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills
• Proven experience leading and developing compliance teams

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in Brussels - International company

jobs.description:
Our client is a fast-growing international healthcare company, combining pharmaceutical expertise with global supply and service capabilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Supporting external audits and acting as the key contact for auditors.
• Preparing audit schedules and year-end statutory accounts.
• Ensuring compliance with local GAAP, IFRS, or other statutory reporting requirements.
• Coordinating audit timelines and resolving audit queries efficiently.
• Performing month end for all aspects of the management accounts
• Ensuring financial processing and authorisation procedures are applied in accordance with approved procedures
• Assisting in the preparation of statutory financial statements for relevant entity in accordance with Local Accounting Standards
• Preparing tax related declarations e.g. VAT, Intrastat and Corporate tax
• Supporting initiatives to obtain tax subsidies

• Degree in a related subject
• Demonstrable audit experience
• Successful track record gained in a similar environment
• Knowledge of in-house finance processes and practices advantageous
• Advanced Excel
• Business level English & French is essential
• Ability to understand and communicate financial matters relating to the Business Units
• Knowledge of IFRS
• Strategic thinker, with the ability to define objectives and develop frameworks
• Ability to work both collaboratively as part of a global team, in an ambiguous, constantly changing environment

Our client is a well-established international industrial manufacturing company with production facilities in Belgium and abroad. The company is recognised for its strong market position and continuous focus on innovation, customer service and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As Supply Chain Manager you will:

• Lead a Supply Chain organisation of 90 fte (of which 6 direct reports) covering demand planning, customer service and transportation planning.
• Develop and enhance forecasting and demand planning processes to improve service levels, forecast accuracy and business performance.
• Define, implement and monitor relevant Supply Chain KPI's and SLA frameworks to support scalable growth.
• Drive customer segmentation initiatives and align differentiated service levels with planning and supply strategies.
• Support the introduction of new product ranges while contributing to product portfolio rationalisation initiatives.

A successful Supply Chain Manager should have:

• Practical capability in coordinating supply chain activities.
• Experience with planning material and product flows.
• Ability to monitor supply chain information and act on operational priorities.
• Knowledge of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Ability to maintain accurate data for planning and follow-up.
• Confidence working with internal stakeholders on supply chain coordination.
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders including Commercial, Product Marketing, Operations and ICT teams to ensure end-to-end supply chain alignment.
• Lead, coach and develop a team of 6 direct reports and approximately 90 indirect reports.
• A good professional level of Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service International - EN, IT, SPA, GER
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international organization operating within the pharmaceutical and health-related sector. Supporting customers across Western Europe, they are known for their commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. To strengthen their Customer Service team, they are looking for a temporary colleague who can help maintain their high service standards.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage customer orders from entry to delivery.
• Communicate with customers, warehouses, and sales teams.
• Handle returns, claims, and transport-related issues.
• Resolve customer inquiries and identify effective solutions.
• Maintain accurate documentation and ERP administration.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• 1-3 years of experience in customer service or administration.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics or Axapta.
• Fluent in English; Spanish, Italian of German are a strong plus.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to perform under pressure.

Our client is a well-established and respected organization active in the automotive sector. They offer a collaborative environment, professional training opportunities, modern working practices, and a strong focus on employee development and work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and follow up on B2B collection files.
• Analyze outstanding debt cases and monitor recovery procedures.
• Contact customers via phone, email, and written correspondence regarding overdue payments.
• Send payment reminders and formal notices.
• Maintain and update administrative records and internal systems.
• Coordinate with external partners, legal representatives, bailiffs, and internal departments.
• Monitor accounting statuses and liaise with the finance team.
• Prepare tailored repayment proposals.
• Ensure proper follow-up of ongoing legal and collection procedures.
• Identify risks and suggest process improvements to management.

Profile We're Looking For

• 3  years experience in credit collection and credit control
• Medior level professional with a structured way of working.
• Comfortable working in a B2B environment.
• Interest in legal procedures and debt recovery processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills.
• Good communication skills and confidence when dealing with customers.
• Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Good command of French; Dutch or English is a strong advantage.
• Comfortable using different IT systems and tools.

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager Top 3 - Retail Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading distributor. It has a strong presence across the Belgian market with a portfolio of well-known consumer brands in Retail and E-commerce. The organization focuses on innovation, sustainability, and improving everyday life through practical and high-quality products. Operating within a global network, it combines local market expertise with international resources. Its Belgian team plays a key role in driving commercial growth and strengthening relationships with major retail partners.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager - Top 3 - Retail will have the following responsibilities:

• Full management and oversight of a portfolio of key accounts
• Negotiation of customer agreements and commercial contracts
• Development of strategic plans for each client and preparation of sales forecasts
• Monitoring and analysis of customer performance, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth
• Ensuring the distribution of permanent product ranges and promotional activities
• Budget management and monitoring
• Close coordination with marketing teams to maximize product distribution across the brand portfolio within key accounts

• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Key Account Manager
• Experience with Top 3 clients is a big plus 
• Good communication skills, analytical, team player
• Fluent in both Dutch and French, with good command of English
